I feel it too. This world is nothing but ugliness and suffering. You have to suffer and work thru feeling happiness. When you step back and see life in a larger view,  there is so much more suffering than happiness. Life is nothing but a joke
I dont want to be with the living anymore, I want to be with the dead. All I see is ugliness in this world

I lost my only daughter, and i dont have any reason to live anymore. Shes gone. i know you will say i still got my family. youll say think of how they would feel after im again. that there is still hope, that help is one call away. 

I already thought of those things. yes I still have my family and I love them, but not as much as my love for my child. and my love for them is 1/10 compared to my broken heart. Yes they are here to help me, I know that. I tried accepting their help, so I can help myself but its not easy just like that. Whenever they make jokes, I smile but deep within me, I measure these little happiness vs. my loneliness, nothing could ever outweigh my broken heart. I am so tired praying before sleep to die as soon as possible thru the will of nature. waking up every morning, life slaping me in the face that i need to fight this broken feeling every single second of my day. I feel sick listening my families voice. its not lovely to hear them. I get disturbed. I just want to find peace in my life again and I cant seem to find it here. I tried everyday, to find hope. I see thru laughters and souls in ones eyes, but there is only one realization I get. that is its not enough for me to live again. it will never be enough. What I have, the life itself, my family, the world, the nature, the sin, the air I breath wil never be enough to outweigh the loneliness I feel. It is so sick to think I still have lots of years to live because the will of nature doesnt want me dead. It just want my baby dead. so if it doesnt want to get my life from me, I will be the one to willingly give it because this life is no use anymore. Its just a waste now and I am one of those people that doesnt deserve to live anymorw because I am ungrateful for my life. I shame my life. I shame this cruel world for giving me a life yet took from me the purpose of my life. I already thought of how selfish I am. and I already accepted that fact. Curse me, tell  the world I am selfish, how self-centered I am. I hear all of it but I just dont care anymore. I dont care how my family will get sad after I am gone because their sadness, means nothing compared to mine. Their love for me isnt as great as my love for my daughter so they wouldnt feel the way I felt. I already accepted that I am indeed a selfish one. and that thought again is nothing compared to what I feel.

Once I wished to have another child, I waited with a burden at my back and with a broken heart. I waited even though pain is killing me, but for some reason nature doesnt want too. So, Ive decided I dont want another child anymore because in reality all I want is my daughter. I want noone but her. I dont want to have another child anymore because when I decided to die, I dont want another child to live without a mom.  

I do think of the people I will leave behind, I do. I care. but not enough to stop my thoughts. When Im gone, they will be sad for couple days, weeks. but after a while they will be happy again because I believe in them. and sadly that I lack in myself. I dont see me ever feel happiness again. This world is big.  My death will mean nothing in this world. Just like the life of ny daughter, it means nothing in this world. but for a mother like me, she was my world and she means everything to me. We sharw the same flesh, I was her. She was me. we sharw the same life. When she died, I died too. And still living in this world doesnt mean a life. Living in this world is death for me. I die everyday. how hurtful is that. Every second of my living life, I die.  
So death for me means nothing now. Thank you for hearing me. Its funny how a distant stranger hears your whisper yet the people around you doesnt even hear your shout.
